name: vue-design
description: Build a screen from a design hand-off (Figma frame links read through the Figma MCP server, or PNG mockups) in the Vue 3 + PrimeVue 4 + Tailwind 4 admin console. Scored continuously on visual similarity, layout, behaviour and accessibility.

tasks.prompt:
Implement this design from Figma.
Desktop: https://www.figma.com/design/Xk3dQ9vLm2PaRt7YwZb4Nc/Acme-Console-Analytics?node-id=12-2&m=dev
Mobile: https://www.figma.com/design/Xk3dQ9vLm2PaRt7YwZb4Nc/Acme-Console-Analytics?node-id=12-3&m=dev
State, row menu open: https://www.figma.com/design/Xk3dQ9vLm2PaRt7YwZb4Nc/Acme-Console-Analytics?node-id=12-4&m=dev
State, last 7 days selected: https://www.figma.com/design/Xk3dQ9vLm2PaRt7YwZb4Nc/Acme-Console-Analytics?node-id=12-5&m=dev
State, empty workspace: https://www.figma.com/design/Xk3dQ9vLm2PaRt7YwZb4Nc/Acme-Console-Analytics?node-id=12-6&m=dev

Implement it at route /analytics; the data source is src/services/analytics.ts.
The date-range control is labelled "Date range", and the row menus are icon buttons labelled "Row actions".

screenshot-only.prompt: Implement this screen from the mockups in design/analytics/ (desktop, mobile and three states). Implement it at route /analytics; the data source is src/services/analytics.ts. The date-range control is labelled "Date range", and the row menus are icon buttons labelled "Row actions".

checks.label: Visual similarity to the mockups (SSIM + colour, baseline-normalised, mean over frames)
Key elements present, in order and where the design puts them
Row menu, date range, desktop row, mobile stacking and empty state work as drawn
axe-core WCAG A/AA on every frame state, scaled by layout coverage
